title: The variety of Lie algebra representations
authors: Bruna Mariana Braido da Silva Percinotti
summary: We study the affine variety $L_{n}(\mathfrak{g})$ of Lie algebra representations, the collection of all homomorphisms from an arbitrary $n$-dimensional Lie algebra into a fixed real semi-simple Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$. Using techniques from real Geometric Invariant Theory, we equip this variety with a natural moment map and associated energy functional arising from the action of the real reductive group $GL(n,\mathbb{R}) \times \text{Inn}(\mathfrak{g})$.
